**Project Overview**
- **Goal:** iOS app to classify waste (Recycle, Compost, Trash, Biological, Electronic) using on-device Core ML models.
- **Current model:** Recycling-Net-11 downloaded and prepared in `` (see `MODEL_SETUP_COMPLETE.md`).
- **Pipeline:** PyTorch → ONNX → Core ML conversion scripts exist under `` (see `model-pipeline.md`); virtualenv at `` is configured.
- **Architecture:** Inference Engine, Signal Fusion, Recommendation Service designed in `RecycleMVPKit` with Swift model loader scaffolding (see `architecture.md`).
- **Requirements:** Target iOS 16+, offline/ANE inference, median latency <600ms, ≥90% accuracy target (see `requirements.md`).
- **Decisions:** Recycling-Net-11 recommended for MVP; quantization (int8/float16) planned to reduce bundle size and improve ANE performance (see `model-comparison.md`).

**Current Status**
- Model downloaded (SafeTensors) and conversion/quantization scripts created.
- `RecyclingNet11.mlpackage` generation pipeline present but not yet run to produce final packaged model in `` (scripts ready in `convert_to_coreml.py` and `quantize_coreml.py`).
- Swift loader and basic tests scaffolding added; image preprocessing logic and full Camera integration remain TODO.

**Recommended Next Steps**
- **Immediate (high priority):**
  - Run conversion: activate `ml_env` and run `python3 scripts/convert_to_coreml.py` to produce `RecyclingNet11.mlpackage`.
  - Quantize: run `python3 scripts/quantize_coreml.py` and prefer the int8 variant for shipping.
  - Implement precise image preprocessing (resize, normalize per `preprocessor_config.json`) in `ModelLoader.swift`.
- **Integration & Validation:**
  - Add the chosen `.mlpackage` to the Xcode target and wire `ModelLoader` into the camera capture pipeline (CameraCaptureKit).
  - Run unit tests (`swift test`) and device latency tests on iPhone 12/13 to verify <600ms median and <1.5s worst-case.
  - Validate accuracy on curated validation set (target ≥90%).
- **Optimization & Hardening:**
  - Profile with Xcode Instruments to confirm ANE usage and energy impact.
  - Add confidence-threshold UX path for low-confidence predictions and telemetry opt-in.
  - Implement model update mechanism (signed manifests) if over-the-air updates needed.
- **Questions to confirm:**
  - Acceptable model size for app store bundle (float32 vs int8).
  - Priority of ANE vs broad device support (fallback CPU only).
  - Desired cadence for model updates and telemetry policy.
